scannerComparison.scoringRule: A file is CORRECT only when the mapped episode exists in the assigned season. metadata.type==="special" is Seanime fallback for "franchise matched, episode number did not fit", so it is scored against the season episode count too; type "nc" (creditless) counts as correct.
scannerComparison.headline: Seanime 82.3% correct with ZERO wrong matches vs Study OS best case 50.0% with 31 wrong matches.
scannerComparison.structuralReason: Seanime resolves seasons and converts absolute episode numbers to season-relative. Verified: The Big O split across AniList 567 (files 01-13) and 129608 (14-26 as eps 1-13); SPYxFAMILY abs 48-50 -> S3 eps 10-12; Frieren abs 35 -> S2 ep 7. Study OS has no season model, so every file lands on season 1.
scannerComparison.caveat: Jikan returned HTTP 504 throughout, so Study OS fell back to AniList (its designed behaviour). The Jikan primary was never exercised.
